title: Fret Mechanism Harness v1
problem: Self-drawn UI parity work needs a mechanism-first harness that can discover layout, invalidation, hit-test, overlay, and focus defects before they appear as manual component screenshots. This lane turns controlled mechanism fixtures plus UI Gallery or focused diagnostics gates into an end-to-end defect-finding loop.

repro.summary: Run the mechanism harness slices: scalar metrics, layout primitives, layout dirty/view-cache invalidation fixtures, scroll-handle invalidation fixtures, prepaint virtual-list window-update fixtures, environment view-cache invalidation fixtures, hit-test routing fixtures, pointer occlusion routing fixtures, pointer-capture owner/cancel, multi-pointer pointer-session, docking viewport-capture, and ContextMenu branch/corridor runtime gates, focus barrier routing fixtures, semantics relation fixtures, Pressable key-activation fixtures, combobox active-descendant interaction fixtures, roving focus/typeahead interaction fixtures, flat, nested, and retained-tree stale-parent focus scope interaction fixtures, shadcn focus-restore recipe fixtures for dialog/popover/drawer/combobox/select/dropdown-menu/context-menu Escape, outside-press, focus-outside, and submenu restore policy outcomes, shadcn recipe typeahead fixtures for select/dropdown-menu/menubar printable-key outcomes, focused view-cache/environment/pointer/focus/semantics/recipe gates, virtual-list boundary owner/reason gates, DataTable retained filter-shrink input-change runtime diagnostics, the UI Gallery checkbox underflow diagnostics gate, the UI Gallery overlay/focus diagnostics suite including Drawer underlay blocking and Combobox outside-press focus restore, the Separator hidden-semantics runtime gate, the Accordion expanded-semantics mutation gate, the Accordion focusable-disabled keyboard/action suppression runtime gate, Combobox/Command active-descendant mutation runtime gates, the Sonner live-region mutation runtime gate, Select/Tabs selected-state mutation runtime gates, the Switch choice-card checked-state semantics runtime gate, the Checkbox disabled action-state runtime gate, the Slider numeric action-state runtime gate plus duplicate thumb test-id repair, the Checkbox table mixed checked-state runtime gate and checked_state_is diagnostics predicate, the Toggle pressed-state runtime gate and pressed_state_is diagnostics predicate, the Input required/invalid form-state runtime gate and required_is/invalid_is diagnostics predicates, the Select invalid form-state runtime gate, the Textarea required/invalid form-state runtime gate, and the InputOTP invalid/required form-state runtime gate, Command/DataTable/retained Virtual List collection-metadata mutation runtime gates, the retained Tree hierarchy level/expanded mutation runtime gate, the DataTable pagination disabled/invoke action-state mutation runtime gate, the retained Tree selected/invoke action-state mutation runtime gate, and the retained Tree dynamic disabled/focus/invoke suppression runtime gate, the Select cross-root relation-edge runtime gate, the HitTestOnly paint-cache replay runtime gate, and the desktop repeating-timer redraw-starvation repair that unblocks the broad shadcn runtime-evidence suite, and the runner repeating-timer overlap stress gate.
